content.text: Submitted. The only repair needed was the format wording and the 30-day anchor: the inserted Section 11.5 now expressly requires return of Customer Data "in a standard machine-readable format" "[w]ithin thirty (30) days after expiration of this Agreement or any termination of this Agreement for any reason," followed by deletion and written certification. Section 11.4's existing six-month, then-current-rates assistance is left byte-for-byte intact, so the proposal sits squarely at the complete preferred level and all official checks pass.
